user.title: Import a Bluetooth Mesh network
user.description: Import a Bluetooth SIG Mesh network to expose its lamps in Home Assistant.

data_description.connect_json: Open your ThingOS / Häfele Connect Mesh .connect export file in a text editor and paste its entire contents here. It contains the network keys and node list.

error.invalid_connect: The pasted text is not a valid .connect network export. Paste the full contents of the exported file.

abort.already_configured: This mesh network is already configured.

proxy_unreachable.title: No Bluetooth proxy for mesh network {network}
